general_formula: a_n=n²=n×n; n is an integer from0 through100 inclusive
narration_strategy: Every term has a formula prefix E000..E100, followed by one result N000..N100. The superscript2 is explained in the intro, not spoken again every term.

voice_reference.status: planned; no episode speech adoption gate yet

boundary_definition: Normal boundary: previous N result speech END to next E formula-prefix speech START, not N-start to N-start. At n0/4/10/32, the boundary contains0.4s before explanation + explanation speech + final2.0s. After final n100, explanatory block and outro follow.

checkpoint_types.4: look ahead to 5×5 without revealing result25 until N005
checkpoint_types.10: 100 unit tiles and transition to labelled diagram

timing_method: Every event length=English word_count×60/150. Hyphenated cardinal parts count individually. Gaps are designed editorial intervals. No estimated speech window is an adopted or measured PCM duration.
duration_formula_seconds: S_all_adopted_utterances + 223.160; replace every provisional event length and start/end using measured PCM.
runtime_contingency: Before production, measure all adopted natural-speed speech and recalculate the complete timeline. If shorter than480s, extend the integer-n range to a documented endpoint, first reconsidering n150→22500, regenerate all mathematics/script/layout checks, and update the endpoint narration and mockups. Do not slow speech, stretch normal2s boundaries, repeat formulas, or add silent holds merely to reach8minutes.

source_reuse_review.scope: 18 result-only WAVs: n0..17; exact text/source SHA/gate acceptance and actual PCM duration inspected. No source copied or adopted for the square episode. Formula-prefix and new dialogue audio not available from this review.

not_performed: new TTS generation and speech adoption
